article.title: Quorum.
article.content: Unless the articles require a larger number, one-fourth of the total membership shall constitute the quorum at a general meeting.
article.html:
378YQuorum.

Section 378Y · Chapter XXIA · Part III · page 213 of the Act

Unless the articles require a larger number, one-fourth of the total membership shall constitute the quorum at a general meeting.
